courseChanges.from: 32 点官方计时表（176.865 km，14 个中途补给点）

note.zh-CN: 2026-11-08 复核时旧 32 点表已不显示；本页分段与补给均改用 17 点表，旧表只作历史口径保留。
note.en: On 2026-11-08 the earlier 32-point table was no longer displayed; segments and services here now use the 17-point table, and the old table is kept only as a historical basis.

details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 UTMB stat block: 174 km. The same official page also says approximately 170 km in its introduction and its current 17-row timing table totals 173.6 km; a raw parse of the official GPX measures 173.83 km. The 32-point table totalling 176.865 km that this page previously cited is no longer displayed and is kept only as a historical basis. This card uses the stat block; the page tables use the 17-row table.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 UTMB stat block: 9,700 m positive gain. The current 17-row official timing table totals +9,700 / −9,699 m and the introduction says about 10,000 m; a raw GPX parse sums to +10,253 m. This card uses the stat block; the page tables use the 17-row table.
